mio.review:
Faculty Review: MIO 
Course :Che202 (Bio-Organic Chemistry)
First of all, I would like to say that this course is quite challenging. It covers not only some of the topics we studied in HSC Organic Chemistry but also introduces more advanced material. The course includes stereochemistry, nomenclature, and a wide range of organic reactions, which makes it a little difficult for almost every student.
One important thing I have learned is that class attendance is absolutely essential. If you miss even a single class, it becomes very difficult to follow the next topics, and you may feel completely lost.
Regarding MIO sir, there is not much review available about him, so I would like to share my experience. 
He is a very hardworking teacher who puts in a lot of effort , He is also available during office hours.
He took Total 3 quizzes and 1 assignment  just because we were lagging behind. (Counts best 2)
In mid and final he gave 3 marks bonus . In my section we got highest 28/30 but in average the marks were bad so He gave all 30 of us 2 marks bonus (28/28) just to boost our grades.
Also He will provide sample questions and important topics for both mid and final .
Just try to be present in every class and study regularly, Che202 is not like other courses that you can just cram one night before exam and do well ,You need to go through the material at least once after the lecture properly. 
 As evidence supporting my statement I would like to say I was present in 21/22 lectures and got an A (Alhamdulillah) , I visited Sir in his office hours with lots of problems because when you go through the lecture and solve the practice questions you will face problems. But Unfortunately you can't solve them if you wait till exam night to study Hence the bad grade !
Best of luck Everyone!!
